params.name: period
params.description: The size of each date range is expressed as an interval to be added to the lower bound. It supports Date Math Syntax. Valid options are `+` following an integer number greater than 0 and one of the Date Math keywords. e.g. `+1DAY`, `+2MINUTES` and `+1MONTH`. Here are [Supported keywords](https://newsapi.aylien.com/docs/working-with-dates#date-math).
